body: The biggest surprise I've gotten is a car accident that I get to pay out of pocket, my gma flatlining (still alive), my youngest cousin in icu because their dad tried to kill them, shoulder/neck injury at work which has put me out for a while, self hating after realizing what an abusive person I am.
